- Kneel on the floor, sit back on your heels, and reach your arms forward on the floor, lowering your chest toward your thighs.

**2. Supine Knee-to-Chest Stretch:**  
- Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.  
- Bring one knee up toward your chest, holding it with both hands.  
- Hold for 20–30 seconds, then switch legs.  
- You can also bring both knees to your chest for a deeper stretch.

- Move slowly and gently—don’t force any stretch.

- Try these stretches once or twice a day, especially after warming up a bit.

When you’re ready, you can come back to your cooking, your logs, and your community with fresh energy and perspective. And if you want to talk more about what’s on your mind, or just need a little encouragement, I’m always here to listen.

Take care of yourself tonight. You deserve it.
